title: SMD_A&CM_ RFQ'S 523158 & 523159 - IDIQ CONTRACT FOR JOC ENVIRONMENTAL SERVICES CITYWIDE
agency_path: City of New York > Housing Authority
submit_to: 90 Church Street, 6th Floor, New York, NY 10007
description_text:
The Contractor shall provide all labor, supervision, materials, equipment, and incidentals necessary to identify, manage, and remediate environmental hazards including, but not limited to, lead, asbestos, mold, and other hazardous materials in compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

Work shall include site assessments and testing; regulatory compliance and permitting; establishment of containment measures; abatement, removal, or encapsulation of hazardous materials; proper handling and disposal of waste; air monitoring and clearance testing; emergency response services; and complete documentation and reporting.

The Contractor shall coordinate all activities with the Owner and relevant stakeholders to ensure safe execution and minimal disruption. All work shall be performed in a safe, timely, and professional manner in accordance with JOC contract requirements.
